title: Invoiced engagements: track services work per account and invoice it
description: Ryan, 2026-11-10: set up the DataParade work as an engagement we invoice; a common pattern to support and test with DataParade. Build the Engagements page and the account's engagements section from the approved Anthus One design (Admin-Engagements, Admin-Account, Admin-Raise-Invoice boards): engagement records under prospectus-central/billing/engagements/ (ongoing with a monthly amount; setup package with price, weeks and stages; status proposed/active/ended; lead; start/end), invoice line items that name the engagement they bill, Raise an invoice suggesting each active engagement's line, last-invoiced shown on each engagement, and a Today follow-up for an ongoing engagement whose last complete month is not invoiced. Issuing stays a person's decision. Then set up DataParade: ongoing monthly retainer from 2026-10-01, led by Ryan, and enter invoice 202610-001 (issued 2026-10-31 outside Prospectus) linked to it. Spec: features/billing-engagements.feature.
